language.description: Language of the Codi interface. System default follows your browser or OS language.

notifications.description: System alerts when a thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval. Applies to this device while Codi is open.
notifications.needsHttps: Notifications need a supported browser over HTTPS, or the desktop app. Sound only is still available.
notifications.unavailable: Notifications are unavailable in this browser. Sound only is still available.
notifications.denied: Allow notifications in your browser or system settings, then choose this option again. Sound only is still available.
notifications.inAppDescription: Show a toast when another thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval while this app has focus.

sidebar.projectOrderDescription: Order of projects in the sidebar project picker and command palette.
sidebar.workingShelfDescription: Fold working and monitoring threads into a Working section. They return to the top of the inbox when they need you. The boring sidebar in Labs has no Working section.

confirmations.unpinDescription: Ask before unpinning a thread from the pinned section.
confirmations.archiveDescription: Require a second click on the inline archive action before a thread is archived.
confirmations.deleteDescription: Ask before deleting a thread and its chat history.
confirmations.quitDescription: Hold mode also quits on two quick presses.

display.timeFormatDescription: System default follows your browser or OS clock preference.

text.chooseHowNewWorktreeBranchesAre: Choose how new worktree branches are named from your first message.
text.forExampleT3OrT3Produces: For example, t3 or t3/ produces t3/add-search. Leave empty for no prefix.
text.appendedToTheNamingPromptThe: Appended to the naming prompt. The model returns the complete branch name; no prefix or suffix is added.
text.mixedEnterInstructionsToApplyTo: Mixed. Enter instructions to apply to all selected targets.
text.useJuliusFollowedByTheIssue: Use julius/ followed by the issue ID and a short description.
text.clickingAPullRequestLinkOpens: Clicking a pull request link opens it in Codi. Turn off to open pull request links like any other link, on your git host.
text.thisProjectIsNoLongerAvailable: This project is no longer available.
text.thisCheckoutIsNoLongerAvailable: This checkout is no longer available in the selected project and environment.
text.machinesYouTrustHereCanRead: Machines you trust here can read PR data through each other's source control access. Enable both machines. Read and act may use broader permissions than the machine that owns them. This applies only to this device.
text.couldNotSavePullRequestRouting: Could not save pull request routing permission

text.showFormattedMarkdownAsYouType: Show formatted Markdown as you type.
text.chooseWhenEnterSendsAPrompt: Choose when Enter sends a prompt or inserts a new line
text.alsoIncludeSkillsInTheCommand: Also include skills in the / command menu. Skills always appear when you type $.
text.chooseColorsForAdditionsAndDeletions: Choose colors for additions and deletions, including change counts.
text.showDiffsStackedOrSideBy: Show diffs stacked or side by side. The toggle in the diff toolbar changes this too.
text.setWhetherTheDiffPanelIgnores: Set whether the diff panel ignores whitespace-only edits by default.
text.startWithFilesExpandedOrCollapsed: Start with files expanded or collapsed when opening diffs or a pull request's Code tab.
text.openLinkedPullRequestsFirstOtherwise: Open linked pull requests first. Otherwise, open Changes for edits to at least 3 files or 50 lines.
text.openPullRequestsAndChangesPanels: Open pull requests and changes panels proactively
text.whenToCompactAnIdleClaude: When to compact an idle Claude thread over 200,000 tokens: after you return, just before its prompt cache expires, or never. Each Claude provider can override this.
text.leaveEmptyToUseWhenThe: Leave empty to use "~/" when the Add Project browser opens.
text.automaticallyResumeThreadsWhenTheirUsage: Automatically resume threads when their usage limits reset. You can cancel auto-resume in each thread.
text.snoozeThreadsUntilTheirUsageLimits: Snooze threads until their usage limits reset. Enable auto-resume to continue the agent after the reset.
text.settleAThreadWhenItsPull: Settle a thread when its pull request merges. Closed pull requests still settle automatically.
text.sidebarThreadsWithNoActivityFor: Sidebar threads with no activity for this long settle automatically.
text.anyNewActivityUnSettlesA: Any new activity un-settles a thread automatically.
text.inactivityDoesNotSettleThreadsWith: Inactivity does not settle threads with a pull request. Merge and close still do.
text.usedForThreadTitlesAndOther: Used for thread titles and other generated text on connected devices with this provider. Source control can override it.
text.connectAnEnvironmentToChooseIts: Connect an environment to choose its text generation model.
text.theSelectedTargetsUseDifferentStreaming: The selected targets use different streaming modes.
text.chooseWhatTheThreadDetailsCard: Choose what the thread details card shows. You can also right-click the card.
text.appendedToThePromptForNew: Appended to the prompt for new and regenerated thread titles.
text.keepTitlesToAFewWords: Keep titles to a few words. Lead with the main subject.
